name: layerbridge
description: Read, edit and export the Figma file open in the bridge plugin. No REST API, no rate limits.
long_description: A local MCP server for the Figma plugin of the same name. Import the plugin from its manifest once (run `npx -y layerbridge@latest setup` to get the path), open it in the Figma file you want Claude to work on, and keep its window open. Everything stays on your computer.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port the Figma plugin connects to. Choose the same port in the plugin panel.

output_root.title: Export folder
output_root.description: Folder that export tools (assets, tokens, screenshots, PDFs) may write into.

access_token.title: Figma access token (optional)
access_token.description: Personal access token for the REST tools: comments, version history, team files. Leave empty to keep everything local.

allow_scripts.title: Allow run_script
allow_scripts.description: Let the run_script tool execute Plugin API code in the open file.
